code.title: Your 12-word recovery code
code.explain: Write these words down, in order, and keep them safe. You need them to restore your boxes on a new phone. Nobody, not even BoxTap, can recover them for you.
code.mismatch: That doesn't match. Look at what you wrote and try again.

restore.newer: This backup was made by a newer BoxTap. Update BoxTap first.
restore.replaceWarning: Restoring replaces everything in BoxTap on this device.

drive.explain: BoxTap keeps an encrypted copy of your boxes in your own Google Drive while the app is open. Nobody can read it without your 12-word code.

install.title: Install BoxTap first
install.why: Installed, BoxTap keeps your boxes safe on this phone and opens like an app. Do it now, before you add more boxes.
install.iosStep1: Tap the Share button (the square with an arrow) at the bottom of Safari.
install.iosStep2: Scroll down and tap "Add to Home Screen", then "Add".
install.iosStep3: Open BoxTap from the new icon on your home screen.
install.iosNote: Boxes you added here in Safari don't move to the icon by themselves. Back up here (Settings → Back up now), then restore in the installed app.
install.iosChrome: On iPhone, install from Safari: open this page in Safari first.
install.androidStep: Tap Install. Or open the browser menu (⋮) and tap "Install app" or "Add to Home screen".
install.desktopStep: Click the install icon in the address bar, or the browser menu → "Install BoxTap".
home.backupDue: Back up your boxes: it's been over a week.
